newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia-Thai authority confirms earlier gas find.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia-Thai authority confirms earlier gas find.

text.p: Tests on an appraisal well in the Malaysia-Thai Joint Development Area (JDA) have confirmed earlier gas finds in the Muda gas field, a statement by the JDA authority said on Tuesday.
Malaysia's Petronas Carigali (JDA) Sdn Bhd and Thailand's PTTEP International Ltd have completed drilling and testing of the Muda-2 appraisal well, the Malaysia-Thailand Joint Authority said.

The well was drilled to a total depth of 2,398 metres. The tests yielded a combined stable gas flow rate of 35 million standard cubic feet a day plus 194 barrels a day of condensate measured through choke sizes of 36/64-64/64 inches.
The two contractors have plugged and abandoned the well, the statement said.
Last week, the JDA authority confirmed earlier gas finds in the field after drilling and testing the Muda-3 appraisal well.
